title: Tales of the Abyss
titleNative: テイルズ オブ ジ アビス
synopsis: Fonons. Essential components of all matter on planet Auldrant. Ages ago, a new type of fonon was discovered—the Seventh Fonon. Its discovery threw humanity into chaos, for if one could use the Seventh Fonon, one could learn the future. Wars over the Seventh Fonon raged across the lands, ending only when the miasma—a poison from within the planet—covered the entire world. This is when Yulia appeared. A fonist skilled in prophecy, Yulia saw thousands of years into the future and foresaw a way to seal away the miasma. With the guidance of her prophecies, humanity sealed the miasma deep within the planet. Over two thousand years passed. The world is ruled by Yulia's prophecy, known as the Score. People believe in the coming “unprecedented prosperity” promised in the Score, never straying from the path set forth in the Score which will lead them to that prosperity. They look to the Score as revealed by the Order of Lorelei, the religion Yulia founded, and hold that the greatest virtue is to follow the Score faithfully. The person who appeared before her, the local famous yankee, x passive beautiful girl. "I didn't think it would be fun to just go through each day mindlessly." Miyuki was the target of bullying among the class girls. Abandoned to all forms of harassment, abuse and sometimes violence... "to combat them, I went to school automatically, and then I worked part-time at a convenience store. I just wanted to end this loop." However, Miyuki's monochrome daily life changed when she met Onitsuka, the leader of the delinquents. "Sometimes it's hard, but when I'm with this person, the world starts to shine."

title: Sherlock + Academy
titleNative: シャーロック＋アカデミー
synopsis: The need for detectives has dramatically increased in response to the increasing number of violent crimes. This year, a boy and a girl enter Marimine Detective Academy, an ultra-exclusive school, and the only one in Japan that offers the "National Detective License." The boy is Misaki Fujisaki, the grandson of the man who was once known as the "Crime King." The girl is Shia E. Hazeldine, the adopted daughter of the man known as the "Detective King." These two descendants of sworn enemies will meet each other by chance! And as their school days begin, an incident occurs right from the entrance ceremony!? Moreover, for some reason, Fujisaki's score is higher than Shia's, even though she supposedly solved the mystery first... "I challenge you!" "Don't regret this, princess." This is a unique academy story where students compete to find the truth. This is intellectual excitement at its highest peak! (Source: MFBunko J, translated)

She works diligently everyday at the student council, honing her leadership skills with the goal of becoming Prime Minister someday. But then she runs into Seijiro Tanabe, the handsome but eccentric president of the Biology Club. Swept up by his passion for biological study, Sakura is about to experience the predatory side of Seijiro Tanabe's personality! (Source: Magapoke, translated)

Akio later discovers that not only is the Z tuned to 620 bhp, it's had a dark history of unfortunate accidents with its previous owners. Making matters more complicated is the fact that the last owner shared the same name with Akio. With the "Devil Z," Akio forms a new rivalry with the Blackbird and its driver Tatsuya Shima.
